# EntanglementScaling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The growth of quantum entanglement across network layers as a function of depth and width, which determines the simulability threshold of the QCNN. Understanding entanglement scaling helps TCC/iNEST researchers predict when network complexity becomes classically tractable, guiding resource allocation in hybrid quantum-classical systems.
